YouTube RPM Calculator

RPM (revenue per mille) is the single most useful number in a YouTube channel: what you earn per 1,000 views after YouTube's 45% share. This calculator converts RPM ↔ earnings in both directions. (Not an engine RPM calculator — that's a different tool entirely.)

How to raise your RPM

  • Audience geography: US/UK/CA/AU viewers are worth 3–4× the worldwide average (see RPM vs CPM for multipliers).
  • Niche: finance, tech and B2B niches command 3–8× entertainment RPM.
  • Monetization: 8+ minute videos unlock mid-roll ads and lift RPM 30–60%.
  • Seasonality: Q4 CPMs run 30–80% above Q1.

Frequently asked questions

What is a good RPM on YouTube?

For long-form, under $2 is weak, $2–$5 is typical, $5–$10 is strong, $15+ is exceptional and niche-driven (finance, tech, US audiences). Shorts RPM is structurally lower ($0.02–$0.15).

How do I find my RPM?

YouTube Studio → Analytics → Revenue. That number is already your creator-share RPM; divide by 1,000 for per-view.
